lines.text: 여름이에요. 개미들이 줄지어 먹이를 날라요. 개미를 톡 눌러 봐요!
lines.en: It's summer. The ants march in a line, carrying food. Tap an ant!
segs: It's summer. The ants march in a line, carrying food. Tap an ant!

lines.en: Tap the marching ants!
Now tap the grasshopper!
Tap the green grasshopper!
"Summer is so fun! Tra-la-la~" The grasshopper sings a song.

lines.text: 개미 눈으로 보면 풀잎이 나무처럼 커다래요!
lines.en: Through an ant's eyes, blades of grass look as big as trees!
segs: Through an ant's eyes, blades of grass look as big as trees!

lines.text: 곡식을 톡톡 눌러서 창고로 날라 줘요!
lines.en: Tap the grain to carry it to the storeroom!
segs: Tap the grain to carry it to the storeroom!

lines.en: Tap the yellow grain!

lines.text: 창고 칸이 가득 찼어요! 하나부터 열까지, 열 칸!
lines.en: The storeroom is full! From one to ten, ten rooms!
segs: The storeroom is full! From one to ten, ten rooms!

lines.en: "Let's play together~ Tra-la-la!" the grasshopper sings.
lines.prev: The storeroom is full! From one to ten, ten rooms!

lines.text: 베짱이와 꽃을 톡톡 눌러 봐요. 봄 노래가 이어져요!
lines.en: Tap the grasshopper and the flowers. The spring song keeps going!
segs: Tap the grasshopper and the flowers. The spring song keeps going!

lines.text: 잘했어요! 계속 눌러서 봄 노래를 이어 가요!
lines.en: Well done! Keep tapping to keep the spring song going!
segs: Well done! Keep tapping to keep the spring song going!

lines.text: 지나가던 개미들이 말했어요. "우린 겨울 준비해야 해!"
lines.en: Some ants passing by said, "We have to get ready for winter!"
segs: We have to get ready for winter!

lines.en: "Winter is still far away~" the grasshopper sang again.
lines.prev: Some ants passing by said, "We have to get ready for winter!"

lines.en: Oh no, a rain shower! Pitter-patter, pitter-patter!
segs: Oh no, a rain shower! Pitter-patter, pitter-patter!

lines.text: 큰 잎을 꾹 눌러서 개미들 우산을 펼쳐 줘요!
lines.en: Press the big leaf to open an umbrella for the ants!
segs: Press the big leaf to open an umbrella for the ants!

lines.en: Press the green leaf!
Under the leaf umbrella, the ants are nice and dry.
segs: Under the leaf umbrella, the ants are nice and dry.

lines.text: 베짱이는 혼자 흠뻑 젖었어요. 에취! 그래도 "괜찮아~" 하고 웃었어요.
lines.en: The grasshopper got soaking wet, all alone. Achoo! But the grasshopper said, "It's okay~" and smiled.
segs: The grasshopper got soaking wet, all alone.

lines.en: Autumn has come. Colorful leaves are fluttering down.

lines.text: 도토리를 톡톡 눌러서 창고로 데굴데굴 굴려요!
lines.en: Tap the acorns to roll them to the storeroom, roll, roll!
segs: Tap the acorns to roll them to the storeroom, roll, roll!

lines.en: Tap the acorns!
The storeroom is even fuller with acorns!
segs: The storeroom is even fuller with acorns!

lines.en: The wind is cool. What should we wear in autumn?
segs: The wind is cool. What should we wear in autumn?

lines.en: The T-shirt? Brr, brr~ I'm a little cold.

lines.text: 두꺼운 외투는 아이 더워~ 땀이 뻘뻘!
lines.en: The thick coat? Phew, so hot! Sweat is dripping!

lines.text: 가을엔 무엇을 입을까? 옷을 골라 봐요!
lines.en: What should we wear in autumn? Pick some clothes!
segs: What should we wear in autumn? Pick some clothes!

lines.text: 너무 얇지도, 너무 두껍지도 않은 옷!
lines.en: Not too thin, not too thick!
segs: Not too thin, not too thick!

lines.en: It's the jacket! Tap the sparkly one!
segs: It's the jacket! Tap the sparkly one!

lines.en: That's right! A jacket is just right for cool autumn.
segs: That's right! A jacket is just right for cool autumn.

lines.text: 하얀 눈이 펑펑! 겨울이 왔어요. 호호, 추워라.
lines.en: Big white snowflakes are falling! Winter is here. Brrr, so cold.
segs: Big white snowflakes are falling! Winter is here.

lines.en: What should we wear in winter?
segs: What should we wear in winter?

lines.en: The T-shirt? Brr, brr~ It's too cold!

lines.text: 하하, 수영복은 여름에 입어요~ 앗, 차가워!
lines.en: Ha ha, swimsuits are for summer~ Ooh, it's cold!
segs: Ha ha, swimsuits are for summer~

lines.text: 겨울엔 무엇을 입을까? 옷을 골라 봐요!
lines.en: What should we wear in winter? Pick some clothes!
segs: What should we wear in winter? Pick some clothes!

lines.en: When it snows, keep your head and neck warm!

lines.text: 목도리와 털모자예요! 반짝이는 걸 눌러 봐요!
lines.en: It's the scarf and the fur hat! Tap the sparkly one!
segs: It's the scarf and the fur hat! Tap the sparkly one!

lines.en: That's right! With a scarf and a fur hat, it's warm.
segs: That's right! With a scarf and a fur hat, it's warm.

lines.en: The ants hurried into the warm storeroom.

lines.text: 눈 오는 날, 베짱이가 오들오들 떨며 창고 문을 두드렸어요.
lines.en: On a snowy day, the grasshopper came shivering and knocked on the storeroom door.
segs: On a snowy day, the grasshopper came shivering and knocked on the storeroom door.

lines.text: "개미야, 먹을 것 좀 나눠 줄 수 있니?"
lines.en: "Ant, could you share some food with me?"
segs: Ant, could you share some food with me?
lines.prev: On a snowy day, the grasshopper came shivering and knocked on the storeroom door.

lines.en: The ant asked, "What did you do in the summer?"
segs: What did you do in the summer?

lines.en: "I sang. Tra-la-la~"
lines.prev: The ant asked, "What did you do in the summer?"

lines.en: "Then go dance all winter!"

lines.text: 그때 아기 개미가 말했어요. "그래도 추워 보여요."
lines.en: Then the baby ant said, "But Grasshopper looks so cold."

lines.text: 문을 톡 눌러서 활짝 열어 줄까요?
lines.en: Tap the door to open it wide?
segs: Tap the door to open it wide?

lines.en: Tap the storeroom door!
"Come in, come in! Let's spend the winter together."
segs: Come in, come in! Let's spend the winter together.

lines.en: "Thank you! In return, I'll play you some wonderful music!"
segs: Thank you! In return, I'll play you some wonderful music!
lines.prev: "Come in, come in! Let's spend the winter together."

lines.text: 창고 안이 곡식이랑 도토리로 가득해요! 여름부터 미리 모은 덕분이에요.
lines.en: The storeroom is full of grain and acorns! That's thanks to gathering ahead of time since summer.
segs: The storeroom is full of grain and acorns! That's thanks to gathering ahead of time since summer.

lines.en: They shared a scarf and a fur hat with the grasshopper, too.
segs: They shared a scarf and a fur hat with the grasshopper, too.

lines.text: 먹을 게 이렇게 많으니 친구들도 불러요! 문 앞에 온 친구를 톡 눌러요.
lines.en: There's so much to eat, so let's invite friends! Tap the friend at the door.
segs: There's so much to eat, so let's invite friends! Tap the friend at the door.

lines.en: Tap the ladybug and invite it in!
segs: Tap the ladybug and invite it in!

lines.en: One! A ladybug has come.
Tap the snail and invite it in!
segs: Tap the snail and invite it in!

lines.en: Two! A snail has come.
Tap the pill bug and invite it in!
segs: Tap the pill bug and invite it in!

lines.en: Three! A pill bug has come.
segs: Three! A pill bug has come.

lines.en: Tap the firefly and invite it in!
segs: Tap the firefly and invite it in!

lines.en: Four! A firefly has come.

lines.text: 친구가 넷이나 왔어요! 먹을 게 많아서 모두 나눠 먹을 수 있어요.
lines.en: Four friends came! There's lots of food, so everyone can share.
segs: Four friends came! There's lots of food, so everyone can share.

lines.text: 반딧불이가 불을 밝히고, 겨울 음악회가 시작됐어요!
lines.en: The firefly lit up its light, and the winter concert began!
segs: The firefly lit up its light, and the winter concert began!

lines.text: 베짱이가 겨울 노래를 들려줘요. 가만히 들어 봐요.
lines.en: The grasshopper plays a winter song. Listen quietly.
segs: The grasshopper plays a winter song. Listen quietly.

lines.text: 베짱이랑 친구들을 톡톡 눌러 봐요. 겨울 노래가 이어지고 춤을 춰요!
lines.en: Tap the grasshopper and friends. The winter song goes on, and everyone dances!
segs: Tap the grasshopper and friends. The winter song goes on, and everyone dances!

lines.text: 띠리링~ 짝짝짝! 겨울이 하나도 춥지 않았어요.
lines.en: Tra-la-la~ Clap, clap, clap! Winter wasn't cold at all.
segs: Tra-la-la~ Clap, clap, clap! Winter wasn't cold at all.

lines.en: Warm spring has come. Little sprouts pop up!
segs: Warm spring has come. Little sprouts pop up!

lines.text: 이번엔 베짱이도 함께 날라요. 베짱이를 톡톡 눌러서 영차!
lines.en: This time the grasshopper carries food too. Tap the grasshopper to heave-ho!
segs: This time the grasshopper carries food too. Tap the grasshopper to heave-ho!

lines.en: Tap the grasshopper, heave-ho, heave-ho!
"Heave-ho! I'll sing in summer, and work together, too!"
segs: Heave-ho! I'll sing in summer, and work together, too!

lines.text: 계절 카드를 봄, 여름, 가을, 겨울 순서대로 톡 눌러 봐요!
lines.en: Tap the season cards in order: spring, summer, autumn, winter!
segs: Tap the season cards in order: spring, summer, autumn, winter!

lines.text: 봄은 어디 있을까? 봄 카드를 톡!
lines.en: Where is spring? Tap the spring card!
segs: Where is spring? Tap the spring card!

lines.en: Spring is next! It's the sparkly card.
segs: Spring is next! It's the sparkly card.

lines.en: Tap the spring card!
Tap the spring card!

lines.text: 여름은 어디 있을까? 여름 카드를 톡!
lines.en: Where is summer? Tap the summer card!
segs: Where is summer? Tap the summer card!

lines.en: Summer is next! It's the sparkly card.
segs: Summer is next! It's the sparkly card.

lines.en: Tap the summer card!
Tap the summer card!

lines.text: 가을은 어디 있을까? 가을 카드를 톡!
lines.en: Where is autumn? Tap the autumn card!
segs: Where is autumn? Tap the autumn card!

lines.en: Autumn is next! It's the sparkly card.
segs: Autumn is next! It's the sparkly card.

lines.en: Tap the autumn card!
Tap the autumn card!

lines.text: 겨울은 어디 있을까? 겨울 카드를 톡!
lines.en: Where is winter? Tap the winter card!
segs: Where is winter? Tap the winter card!

lines.en: Winter is next! It's the sparkly card.
segs: Winter is next! It's the sparkly card.

lines.en: Tap the winter card!
Tap the winter card!
"I'm next~"
lines.prev: A season card that is out of order was tapped. The card hops and says,

lines.en: Number one, spring!
Number two, summer!
Number three, autumn!
Number four, winter!

lines.text: 봄, 여름, 가을, 겨울! 계절은 빙글빙글 돌아요.
lines.en: Spring, summer, autumn, winter! The seasons go round and round.
segs: Spring, summer, autumn, winter! The seasons go round and round.

lines.text: 미리 준비하고 함께 나누니, 겨울도 따뜻했답니다.
lines.en: By getting ready ahead and sharing together, even winter was warm.
segs: By getting ready ahead and sharing together, even winter was warm.

cut_sneeze: The grasshopper, soaked by the rain shower, sneezes.
cut_shiver: Brrr, so cold... and hungry too...

ui.미리 준비하고, 함께 나누면 모두 따뜻해요!: Get ready ahead and share together, and everyone stays warm!
